stories.headline: Google DeepMind Unveils Genie 4 World Simulator
stories.blurb: DeepMind released Genie 4, a new generation of world simulation models that enables interactive, playable environment generation for training autonomous agents and powering generative media.

stories.headline: Google Research Introduces 'Sleep' Framework for LLM Retention
stories.blurb: Researchers developed a new framework inspired by human sleep cycles to help large language models retain existing knowledge while continuously learning new information without catastrophic forgetting.

stories.headline: Liquid AI Releases LFM3 Multimodal Specialized Models
stories.blurb: Liquid AI announced LFM3, a family of liquid foundation models designed to deliver efficient multimodal intelligence across edge and domain-specific applications.

stories.headline: Anthropic Uses Claude to Uncover Real-World Zero-Days
stories.blurb: Anthropic published research showing how Claude can autonomously discover and exploit vulnerabilities in critical production software, highlighting both new defensive capabilities and emerging AI security risks.

stories.headline: Critical UEFI Firmware Flaw Threatens Global Server Infrastructure
stories.blurb: A widespread code-execution vulnerability was discovered in standard UEFI firmware, leaving millions of cloud and enterprise servers vulnerable to persistent low-level attacks.

stories.headline: AMD and Meta Partner to Scale AI Superintelligence Hardware
stories.blurb: AMD and Meta expanded their strategic partnership to deploy next-generation accelerators across Meta's global data center footprint for AI model training and inference.

stories.headline: Google and Oracle Partner to Bring TPUs to Oracle Cloud
stories.blurb: Google Cloud and Oracle announced an expansion allowing enterprise customers to deploy Google Cloud TPUs directly within Oracle Cloud Infrastructure environments.

stories.headline: Apple Unveils 14-Inch MacBook Pro Powered by M6 Chip
stories.blurb: Apple announced the latest 14-inch MacBook Pro featuring its next-generation M6 architecture, bringing significant performance boosts for local AI and developer workloads.

stories.headline: Amazon Redefines the Software Engineer Role in the AI Era
stories.blurb: Amazon engineering leadership released updated internal guidelines redefining developer expectations, shifting focus from code generation toward architecture, system verification, and AI orchestration.

stories.headline: Evaluating the Viability and Impact of Autonomous AI SREs
stories.blurb: A detailed technical breakdown explores how AI-driven Site Reliability Engineering tools handle incident response and system maintenance in production environments.

stories.headline: Data Workspace Platform Hex Raises $100M Series C
stories.blurb: Hex secured $100 million in new funding to expand its collaborative analytics and AI-powered data science platform for enterprise teams.

stories.headline: Anthropic Files S-1 Disclosing Huge Growth and Significant Commitments
stories.blurb: Anthropic's public S-1 filing revealed skyrocketing enterprise revenue alongside massive long-term compute commitments as it prepares for one of tech's largest market debuts.

stories.headline: OpenAI Sued Over GPT-4o's Unsupervised Medical Guidance
stories.blurb: A lawsuit filed against OpenAI alleges GPT-4o gave dangerous medical advice that prompted a user to stop necessary prescription medications.
